# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (48) - Meeting Recording Reliability Beta
## Changed
- Recording now tolerates brief saving delays without exhausting the audio buffer pool on small microphone or system-audio callbacks. Memory stays bounded. - If the writer genuinely overloads, audio already accepted is saved before stopping instead of being discarded. - Audio conversion keeps its input memory separate from capture and drains pending output on Stop/Pause. Stereo system audio is covered at 44.1/48 kHz, with small and large callback sizes. - Unexpected stops show a warning on the recorder. The meeting keeps an incomplete-recording notice even after transcription finishes or app restart. A non-sensitive interruption category is saved with the meeting.
There is no 13-minute meeting limit. These changes fix reproduced buffering and conversion defects; they do not establish the cause of an individual recording stopping. Audio after a real stop cannot be recovered if it was never captured.
System audio + microphone remains the default. Selected-app and microphone-only capture, explicit Start, pause/resume, live local Swedish transcription, speaker labels and existing dictation/paste behavior are retained. Capture never silently broadens to another source or restarts automatically.
This release does not include the separate settings reorganization, CLI/cloud summaries, destination sending or Native/Classic appearance work. No audio or text is uploaded by the recording fixes. iOS and Mac TestFlight are unchanged.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Existing history, dictionary, settings and models are preserved. Do not run production, development and TestFlight copies together.
Meetings require Apple silicon and macOS 14.2 or later. Allow microphone and system-audio recording permission. Obtain participants' consent and check the source: System audio includes other apps' and browser tabs' output. Choose a specific app for a narrower scope; headphones help avoid acoustic microphone bleed. Speaker recognition and echo cancellation are not guaranteed.
Verify both MIC and SYS meters and both sides of the saved transcript during a consented call longer than 15 minutes. Check pause/resume and Stop/save, and confirm that the end of each track is retained. Interrupted meetings must remain clearly marked as partial rather than appearing complete.
Automated coverage includes writer stalls, true overload, converted PCM integrity, backward-compatible history and persistent interruption warnings. An accelerated two-hour test retained both tracks across 4,800 bounded files with recovery checks. This is synthetic input, not two hours of real-time call capture or ASR validation. Real-call audio, permissions, routing, traffic auditing, native UI-test execution and live updater replacement remain target-Mac acceptance checks. This is an experimental prerelease, not a stable recording guarantee.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (47) - System Audio Meetings Beta
## Changed
- Meetings now default to System audio + microphone. Your microphone and the Mac's output are captured on separate tracks and transcribed locally. - Starting from a Slack/Teams meeting suggestion uses the same default. The prompt and setup screen explain that system audio includes sounds from other apps and browser tabs. The macOS audio-permission description also reflects this scope. Nothing records before you choose Record or Start. - Select a specific meeting app for narrower output capture, or Microphone only. A missing selected app does not silently fall back to recording all apps. - Pause/resume preserves the original capture source. System-audio capture does not stop merely because a particular meeting app closes. Stop and save the recording explicitly when finished. - The recording readout shows MIC and SYS, with descriptive VoiceOver labels. Transcript playback stays disabled during recording to avoid feeding it back into capture.
Existing dictation hotkeys, auto-paste, local formatting, minimal REC/timer mode, meeting suggestions, live Swedish transcription, speaker labels, corrections, playback after recording, export and audio retention remain available. This release does not include destination sending or the Native/Classic appearance work. iOS and sandboxed Mac TestFlight are unchanged.
## Experimental Scope And Permissions
Meetings require the direct Mac build, Apple silicon and macOS 14.2 or later. Allow microphone and system-audio recording permission. Obtain participants' consent and check the selected source before starting. System audio may include notifications, music and other apps' output; choose a specific app if needed. Microphone input is separate from the digital output tap; headphones help avoid acoustic bleed. Individual speaker recognition and echo cancellation are not guaranteed. Speech recognition remains Swedish-only in this meeting beta.
Suggestions and Calendar context remain opt-in. Microphone activity is a hint, not proof of a call. No microphone or audio tap is opened for detection itself. Calendar data is not uploaded or changed. Audio and transcripts stay local; there is no cloud transcription or meeting-LLM connection.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Existing history, dictionary, settings and models are preserved. Do not run production, development and TestFlight copies together.
For a short consented call, verify System audio + microphone is selected, both MIC and SYS meters respond, and both sides appear in the saved transcript. Check pause/resume and Stop/save. Also try a specific app and Microphone only to confirm their narrower scopes. Recording should not require another app to already be playing audio. Test a detected Slack/Teams suggestion separately.
Automated tests and silent UI fixtures do not establish real two-sided capture, permissions, routing, speaker accuracy or live updater replacement. Those remain target-Mac acceptance checks. This is an experimental prerelease, not a stable meeting-recording guarantee.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (46) - Meeting Suggestions Beta
## New
- Opt-in suggestions when the Slack or Microsoft Teams desktop app uses its microphone. A small tactile prompt offers Start and Not now. Nothing records automatically; detection itself does not open a microphone or audio tap. - Optional Calendar context can supply a matching ongoing or imminent meeting title. Enable it separately in Settings or the meeting setup screen. Calendar access is not required to detect a call or record manually. Mumla never changes events or uploads calendar data. - Suggestions wait for sustained input activity, expire after a minute and are suppressed during Mumla's other work. Brief mute/reconnect transitions do not immediately trigger another prompt. Switching suggestions off stops observation.
## Meeting UI Improvements
- Long meeting titles, source names and speaker labels wrap. Compact windows give the transcript more room, with pause/stop controls kept accessible. - Source, speaker and action pickers follow Mumla's tactile light/dark design. - Correction, deletion and quit-confirmation dialogs now match the app. Deleting audio keeps the transcript; deleting a meeting still requires confirmation.
Existing live local Swedish transcription, on-demand processing, speaker labels, playback, export, dictation hotkeys, auto-paste and minimal REC/timer mode remain available. Destination sending is not included in this release.
## Experimental Scope And Permissions
Meetings and suggestions require Apple silicon, macOS 14.2+ and the direct Mac build. Browser calls and calendar-only reminders are not detected. Microphone activity is a hint, not proof of a call: voice messages or microphone checks can also trigger a prompt. A muted app may not expose input activity until unmuted. If no prompt appears, start recording manually in Meetings.
Calendar permission is optional and only requested when you enable meeting titles from Calendar. macOS requires full event access for this lookup, but Mumla only reads nearby events and never modifies them. Only a suggested title is saved with a recording after you choose Start. Calendar notes, attendees, links and event identifiers are not saved or logged.
Actual recording still requires microphone and system-audio permission. Obtain the participants' consent before recording. Speech recognition remains Swedish only; speaker separation and transcript accuracy remain experimental.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Existing local history, dictionary, settings and models are preserved. Do not run production, development and TestFlight copies together. Suggestions are off by default; enable Suggest meeting recording in Settings or the meeting setup screen.
For a short consented Slack/Teams call, check that the prompt appears, Not now records nothing, and Start selects the correct meeting app. Check both MIC and APP meters and confirm both sides reach the transcript. Test optional Calendar access separately; a denied calendar must not prevent manual recording.
Automated checks and silent UI fixtures do not prove real-call detection, permissions, full-screen placement, audio quality, idle cost or live updater replacement. Those remain target-Mac acceptance checks. This is an experimental prerelease, not a stable meeting-support claim. No iOS or sandboxed Mac TestFlight build is included.
